statement: A company must maintain a registered office that is a Singapore address, open and accessible to the public during normal business hours on each business day, to which ACRA and others can send communications and notices and at which the company's records and registers are kept; it need not be the place where business activities are carried on.
caveat: The registered-office notice is part of the incorporation application (Companies Act 1967 section 19(1)(ba) from 20 October 2026, section 142 otherwise); address changes are filed through Bizfile. Virtual-office and corporate-service-provider addresses are permitted if they meet the accessibility requirement.
